summary.text: Richard "Rick" Spargo is a Democratic candidate for the Arizona House of Representatives, District 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His campaign website describes him as a North Scottsdale resident who started a business 35 years ago.

paragraphs.text: Spargo's campaign website says he has lived in the district for 20 years, is married and raised four children.
It says he has served as state president of the Arizona Sons of the American Revolution and has raised money for a homeless veterans' shelter.
Spargo advanced from the Democratic primary on July 21, 2026.
His campaign site lists affordability, water security, public safety, term limits for the Arizona Legislature, immigration and education among his issues.
